The network at the end of a run

Source: R/run.R
abm_edges.Rd

The network at the end of a run

Usage

abm_edges(x)

Arguments

x

An abm_result from abm_run().

Value

A tibble of from/to edges, or NULL if the model had no network.

Examples

m <- abm_setup(agents = abm_agents(n = 10, x = 1),
               network = abm_network(type = "random", degree = 2))
go <- abm_go(abm_match(pair = "network"),
             abm_rules(x ~ partner_x))
r  <- abm_run(m, go, ticks = 2, seed = 1)
abm_edges(r)
#> # A tibble: 10 × 2
#>     from    to
#>    <int> <int>
#>  1     1     5
#>  2     1     6
#>  3     2     4
#>  4     2    10
#>  5     3     8
#>  6     3     9
#>  7     4     8
#>  8     5     7
#>  9     6     9
#> 10     7    10
